message: The other day, I was trying to gather the kids for a little family chat about our emergency plans. You know, the usual—go-bags, water, and where to meet if we ever had to leave the house. But all they wanted to do was show off their new dance moves! 💃 I realized that making preparedness fun could be the key. So we turned it into a little game, and suddenly, they were excited to help pack their favorite snacks and toys. It reminded me that sometimes, a little creativity can turn a serious topic into a bonding experience. How do you make these discussions fun with your little ones?
